events.title: Community Excellence Open House and Giveaway Event
events.description:
Community Excellence Open House and Giveaway Event
Monday, October 5 | 1:00 PM - 2:00 PM

West Walkway
Join us for the Community Excellence Open House and Giveaway Event and take a few minutes to connect, celebrate, and learn more about the work of the Office of Community Excellence. 
The event will feature:
Karak Konnections Celebration: Celebrate our most highly attended semester in Karak Konnections history with a cup of Karak and snacks.
Meet the CE Committees: Learn more about the work accomplished this fall, as well as the resources and services available to students, staff, and faculty.
Free Gift Bags: The first 100 guests will receive a complimentary gift bag to celebrate the end of the semester.
We hope to see you there!
Wishing you all the best,
Dean Kira & the Members and Volunteers of the Office of Community Excellence

---
